name: RapidTriage core forensics #81-#90 internal fixture validation

datasets.name: #81 known-answer validation fixture assertions

required_assertions: Validation output preserves manifest ingestion, dataset counts, expected assertions, evidence-path checks, evidence file SHA256 values, dataset hashes, manifest digest, public corpus guidance, release gate, trusted known-answer manifest diff helpers/gates, and #81 core_accuracy_gates.

datasets.notes: Internal fixture pass; public CFReDS/CFTT corpus execution, trusted known-answer manifests, and reviewer signoff remain blockers.

datasets.name: #82 parser fixture corpus assertions

required_assertions: Parser fixture corpus output preserves parser areas, fixture/test counts, fixture/test file SHA256 values, area manifest hashes, fixture_corpus_digest, expected edge cases, coverage status, release gate, trusted fixture corpus manifest diff helpers/gates, and #82 core_accuracy_gates.

datasets.notes: Internal fixture pass; broader malformed/deleted/versioned corpus and trusted fixture corpus manifests remain blockers.

datasets.name: #83 FP/FN notes assertions

required_assertions: Parser FP/FN notes preserve false-positive risks, false-negative risks, validation-required guidance, parser scope, quantification warning, risk_note_hash values, minimum quantification fields, reportability boundaries, parser-fp-fn-risk-register-v1 digest, trusted FP/FN risk register diff helpers/gates, and #83 core_accuracy_gates.

datasets.notes: Internal fixture pass; quantified FP/FN rates and reviewed risk register remain blockers.

datasets.name: #84 independent validation report assertions

datasets.notes: Internal fixture pass; actual third-party signed validation and trusted signoff manifest remain operator-owned.

datasets.name: #85 validation package assertions

required_assertions: Validation package outputs preserve JSON, Markdown, artifact hash manifest, validation-package-manifest-v1, artifact hash rows, package_manifest_hash, reproduction commands, known-answer/fixture sections, package limitation warning, trusted validation package manifest diff helpers/gates, and #85 core_accuracy_gates.

datasets.notes: Internal fixture pass; attached release test logs, trusted package manifests, and independent review remain blockers.

datasets.name: #86 chain-of-custody fixture assertions
